description: Defines the LoanProductMinMaxConstraints class which encapsulates minimum and maximum constraints for loan product parameters such as principal amounts, interest rates, and repayment counts. Includes methods for updating constraints based on JSON commands and handling floating interest rates.

classes.name: LoanProductMinMaxConstraints
classes.description: Encapsulates min and max constraints for loan product parameters, with update logic and getters for interest rates.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates constraint values based on input JSON command, tracking changes and handling locale.

methods.name: getMinNominalInterestRatePerPeriod
methods.description: Returns the minimum nominal interest rate per period as BigDecimal, handling nulls.

methods.name: getMaxNominalInterestRatePerPeriod
methods.description: Returns the maximum nominal interest rate per period as BigDecimal, handling nulls.

methods.name: updateForFloatingInterestRates
methods.description: Resets interest rate constraints to null for floating interest rate scenarios.
